verdict.rationale: Sprinto ships scoped built-in AI features you can hand work to: an AI Editor that builds and modifies ingestion workflows from natural-language prompts, Sprinto AI that validates uploaded audit evidence and flags gaps, and AI-assisted due-diligence reviews. These are task-specific tools, not a general in-product assistant you can delegate arbitrary tasks to. The GitHub compliance-skills run in external coding agents, not inside the product, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: a general-purpose in-product AI assistant or agent, delegation across modules beyond workflow editing, evidence review and due diligence, depth on what the AI does autonomously versus suggests, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Sprinto’s AI Editor helps you create and modify ingestion workflows using natural language prompts.
Use Sprinto AI to automatically validate your uploaded evidence for relevance, scope, and timeliness before audit submission.
Sprinto AI analyses your submission and flags gaps such as outdated timestamps or irrelevant screenshots
Sprinto supports both manual and AI-assisted due diligence reviews.
